title: imap: no auth-failure limit allows brute force without disconnect
description: The IMAP session (crates/imap/src/session/mod.rs) has no auth_failure_count mechanism. A client can attempt unlimited LOGIN/AUTHENTICATE commands on a single connection without being disconnected. The reader crate disconnects after MAX_AUTH_FAILURES (3) failures. RFC 3501 §6.1.1 says the server SHOULD disconnect after repeated failures. Fix: track failure count in session context; after N failures (e.g. 3), send tagged NO and then untagged BYE and close the connection.
